event.title: docs(specs): MCP tools capability
event.author: predictable-code[bot]
event.body:
## Why

`predictable specs undocumented` reports 151 of 151 exported functions documented by no capability: the existing spec pages each document one source file, so no capability states what the MCP tool registry as a whole offers an agent. The 16 exports under `mcp/tools` and `mcp/piece-types.ts` (`getComponent`, `listTemplates`, `PIECE_TYPES`, `tools`…) had no capability prose.

## What changed

Adds capability SPEC-263 "MCP tools" (`specs/mcp-tools.spec.md`), covering `mcp/tools` and `mcp/piece-types.ts`, with a description of what each read-only tool returns. No code or test changes.

## Changed after review

Two sentences repeated the names of tests in `mcp/server.test.ts` and said more than the code does. Both now state what the code does:

- `search-components` is a literal text match over names, descriptions, props and docs, with its weights. It does not match by meaning.
- `get-component` suggests a name only when the name contains the query, or the query, longer than 2 characters, contains the name.

## Evidence

- Each sentence of the description has a test in `mcp/server.test.ts` (`npm run test:mcp`: 32 passed), except the details added after review: the weights, the cap of 5 occurrences in the docs, the limit of 8 results and the typo that gets no suggestion. Those were checked by reading `mcp/tools/search-components.ts` and `notFound` in `mcp/tools/shared.ts`; no test covers them.
- After this, 134 exported functions are still documented by no capability (components, tokens, render scripts, runtime).

The analysis did not verify this change: no `predictable fix-check` reported a defect gone for it.
